items.title: Family embroiled in decades-old IVF mix-up files lawsuit against hospital
items.description: The biological parents of twins who were born after an IVF embryo mix-up at Royal North Shore Hospital in Sydney have launched civil action.

items.title: Japanese mall had just reopened before earthquake and explosion
items.description: Before the magnitude-7.1 earthquake hit, the mall had highlighted its seismically reinforced ceilings and improvements to safety and ⁠resilience.

items.title: Motorists to lose fuel discount from Monday
items.description: Drivers will lose the fuel excise discount as planned, despite escalating pressure on global oil prices and warnings the world has depleted reserves.

items.title: US and Saudi Arabia strike Iran-backed militants after 'surprise attack'
items.description: Fresh fighting has erupted after the US accused Iran of launching its first ballistic missile attack on an American base since strikes were paused on Friday. Here's your three-minute briefing on the key developments in the Middle East overnight.

items.title: Judge slams law firm over delayed $120m payout to sacked Qantas staff
items.description: Maurice Blackburn Lawyers has been handling a $120 million payout that Qantas agreed to pay its illegally sacked workers in 2024, with a judge rebuking the delayed compensation.

items.title: Without more oil, a new refinery makes no sense
items.description: Experts say a new refinery would need to use imported oil and question how it would be competitive.

items.title: Deaths of woman and toddler being treated as murder-suicide, police say
items.description: South Australia Police say they are treating the deaths of a woman and her toddler found in water off the state’s south-east coast as a murder-suicide.

items.title: Presumed dead, 'Doctor Jihad' gave a revealing interview about life under ISIS
items.description: An Australian man dubbed "Dr Jihad" claims he never intended to join Islamic State and never pledged allegiance to the extremist organisation, in a recently resurfaced interview.

items.title: Taylor denies giving money to group at centre of NSW corruption probe
items.description: The NSW Independent Commission Against Corruption has seen a series of text messages in which key figures discuss a plan to "shake down" Angus Taylor for financial support.

items.title: Live: Chance of August rate hike tumbles as inflation cools
items.description: The big focus locally is the consumer price index and what it will mean for interest rates. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
